+@pytest.mark.anyio
+async def test_background_task_exception_is_propagated() -> None:
+    response_complete = anyio.Event()
+
+    async def raise_exception() -> None:
+        await response_complete.wait()
+        raise RuntimeError("Background task failed")
+
+    async def app(scope: Scope, receive: Receive, send: Send) -> None:
+        response = PlainTextResponse(background=BackgroundTask(raise_exception))
+        await response(scope, receive, send)
+
+    async def passthrough(request: Request, call_next: RequestResponseEndpoint) -> Response:
+        return await call_next(request)
+
+    middleware = BaseHTTPMiddleware(app, dispatch=passthrough)
+    scope = {"type": "http", "version": "3", "method": "GET", "path": "/"}
+
+    async def receive() -> Message:
+        raise NotImplementedError("Should not be called!")
+
+    async def send(message: Message) -> None:
+        if message["type"] == "http.response.body" and not message.get("more_body", False):
+            response_complete.set()
+
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="Background task failed"):
+        await middleware(scope, receive, send)
+
+
 @pytest.mark.anyio
